To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a new contextual text cube model, called CXT-Cube, which considers contextual factors to better consider the context associated with textual data; we extend our aggregation operator ORank (OLARank) for textual data to consider all contextual factors; we perform an experimental evaluation to demonstrate the importance of integrating contextual factors in the analysis of textual data.

(i) we introduce a new contextual text cube model that considers several contextual factors in the analysis of textual data, and (ii) we extend our OLAP-Rank aggregation operator to consider all the defined contextual factors.
the proposed contextual text cube model is a useful tool for decision-makers to analyze textual data in data warehouses and to consider contextual factors in their decision-making process.
